source.note: The plan's own source (Kenney Mini Skate, scooter.glb with its Textures/colormap.png; zip pinned by sha256, the link read from the kit page as for every Kenney entry). A chunky toy-like kick scooter: a T handlebar on a straight stem, a deck with recessed grip tape, two fat wheels under fenders, 410 tris. Scale: height 0.9 m (top of the handlebar), the low end of a real adult scooter's 0.9-1.0 m, so a ~1.6 m person's hands reach the grips. Kenney draws it stubby, so at that height it is 1.41 m long (real ~0.9-1.0 m) with 0.33 m wheels and a high deck; the aspect cannot be fixed without distorting it. In the kit's own scale beside the Kenney Mini Characters (library height 1.1 m) it would be 0.72 m tall: scale the root by 0.8 for a mini rider. Riding it (at 0.9 m): deck top (grip tape) y = 0.27 m, standing area z = -0.26 to +0.28 m, x = -0.06 to +0.06 m on the tape (deck 0.31 m wide); handlebar grips centred at x = +/-0.27 m (each 0.20-0.33 m out), y = 0.80 m (0.72-0.88), z = +0.53 m; wheels touch y = 0 at z = -0.51 and +0.53 m. Front (stem and handlebar) toward +Z. Look (noon): the frame, stem and deck sides vermilion (accent) over dark brown (iris) shade; wheels and handlebar grips cream (moon) over paper (sky); grip tape and wheel hubs (one source colour) dark brown (iris) both tones, threshold -1 so it never takes a shade. Faceted (smooth false). Static, no clips.
